itinerary.title: KUL - KIX
activities: Osaka Castle Park (second largest park, historical site)
Namba (vibrant, bustling and historic southern downtown, known for shopping and entertainment)
Dotonbori (Osaka's principal tourist and nightlife area)

itinerary.title: Kyoto
activities: Fushimi Inari (thousands of vibrant orange, donor-funded torii gates forming tunnels)

itinerary.title: Nara
activities: Nara Deer Park (famous for its tame deer roaming freely)

itinerary.title: Osaka / USJ
activities: Osaka Bay (Osaka Aquarium, Tempozan Ferris Wheel and Santa Maria Cruise)
Shinsekai (historic, retro-themed entertainment district, famous for the Tsutenkaku Tower)

expect.title: Hotel
expect.body: Rooms are small, typically 12-16 sqf (Japan standard). Triple rooms offer even less space.

expect.title: Lot of Walking

expect.body: Please bring max 1 luggage per person as it will affect car capacity.

expect.title: Meal
expect.body: Exclude lunch and dinner. Guide will bring you to a Halal or Muslim Friendly restaurant.

expect.title: Things Not Mentioned in the Itinerary
expect.body: Must be paid by customers, e.g. Entrance Fee, Shopping etc.

expect.title: Stairs
